evidence_snippets: Use code transformation Gemini Code Assist provides code Transformation , which allows you to select a portion of code in a file and request modifications to your existing code through prompts in natural language, using an inline text box.
To help you comply with any license requirements for your code, Gemini Code Assist provides source citations when its suggestions directly quote at length from a specific source.
